title: Offline Bundle Manifest (bundle-manifest.yaml)
description: Documents the shape `services/distribution-service` (M03) writes into `bundle-manifest.yaml` at the root of every Offline Bundle ZIP (`01-portal-and-distribution.md` §4.2), and that `apps/desktop-client` (M04) reads back on import (`electron/bundle-verify.ts#ParsedManifest`, `electron/bundle-install.ts`). Documentation-only contract, same as `api/knowledge-search.schema.json` — not wired into `ai_asset_schemas.validator` (no SchemaType entry); M03/M04 keep their own hand-written parse/serialize code in sync with this file rather than validating against it at runtime. D-060: added `included_assets[].asset_version_id` so a consumer that needs to *search* a Knowledge item (not just locate its files on disk) has the id search-runtime/agent-runtime actually index by.

asset_id.description: Parent Asset.id. Drives the on-disk/in-zip directory layout (`assets/knowledge/{asset_id}/{version}/...`), which stays Asset-id-keyed for D-060 — only the search identifier moved to asset_version_id, not the file layout.

asset_version_id.description: AssetVersion.id — the id `services/agent-runtime` and `services/search-runtime` actually key Knowledge search by (D-060, distinct from asset_id above; the two are never expected to be equal). `null` for two legitimate cases a consumer must handle without guessing: (1) STANDARD_LOCAL_COPY items (D-034 static standard agent/prompt config) have no backing AssetVersion row at all; (2) Bundles produced before this field existed. A consumer MUST NOT fall back to asset_id when this is null — that silently reintroduces the D-060 bug (a request that looks successful but always returns zero Knowledge search results).
